crossRefs.note: The Philistine said, “I defy the armies of Israel today! Give me a man, that we may fight together!”
The men of Israel said, “Have you seen this man who has come up? He has surely come up to defy Israel. The king will…
David spoke to the men who stood by him, saying, “What shall be done to the man who kills this Philistine, and takes…
Your servant struck both the lion and the bear. This uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, since he has…
Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?” ’ ”
Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe. Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was…
Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. He said, “Yahweh has not chosen this one, either.”
The Philistines stood on the mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on the mountain on the other side: and there…
and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimea the third,

parallels.note: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David’s brother killed him.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jonadab
people.line: Nephew of David, friend and advisor to Amnon

people.name: Shimeah
people.line: Brother of David; father of Jonadab (or 'Jonathan').

translations.web: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David’s brother, killed him.
translations.bsb: and when he taunted Israel, Jonathan the son of David’s brother Shimei killed him.
translations.kjv: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea the brother of David slew him.
translations.asv: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David's brother, slew him.
